KELAS KENDERAAN

Kelas 1: Kenderaan yang mempunyai dua gandar dan tiga atau empat roda

(tidak termasuk teksi dan bas)

Kelas 2: Kenderaan yang mempunyai dua gandar dan lima atau enam roda

(tidak termasuk bas)

Kelas 3: Kenderaan yang mempunyai tiga gandar atau lebih

(tidak termasuk bas)

Kelas 4: Teksi

Kelas 5: Bas

Bagi maksud mengira bilangan gandar dan roda sesebuah kenderaan, gandar dan roda

mana-mana treler yang ditarik oleh kenderaan itu hendaklah dikira sebagai sebahagian

daripada gandar dan roda kenderaan itu.".

Pindaan Jadual Kedua

(a) dengan menggantikan perkataan "15 JULAI 2016 SEHINGGA

31 DISEMBER 2032" dengan perkataan "4 SEPTEMBER 2026

SEHINGGA 31 DISEMBER 2069"; dan

(b) dengan menggantikan perkataan "PLAZA TOL KELUAR: CHENEH/ CUKAI/

KIJAL/ KERTEH/ PAKA/ KUALA DUNGUN/ BUKIT BESI/ AJIL/

TELEMUNG/ KUALA TERENGGANU DI LEBUH RAYA PANTAI TIMURFASA 1" dengan perkataan "PLAZA TOL KELUAR: PELABUHAN KUANTAN/

"JADUAL KETIGA

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Menteri Kerja Raya

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(EAST COAST EXPRESSWAY-PHASE 2) (AMENDMENT) (NO. 2) ORDER 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads

 (Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (East Coast Expressway-Phase 2) (Amendment) (No. 2)

Order 2026.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 4 September 2026.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls) (East Coast

Expressway-Phase 2) Order 2016 [P.U. (A) 195/2016], which is referred to as the

"principal Order" in this Order, is amended—

(a) in subsubparagraph 2(1)(a)—

(i) by substituting for the words "1 February 2020 to 31 December

2058" the words "4 September 2026 to 14 July 2034"; and

(ii) by inserting after the word "including" the words "Kuantan Port

Interchange, Kuantan Port Toll Plaza,"; and

(b) in subsubparagraph 2(1)(b) by substituting for the words "15 July 2016 to

31 December 2032" the words "4 September 2026 to 31 December 2069".

Substitution of First Schedule

3. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the First Schedule the

following schedule:
